Weather Icons 2.0.12 by Erik Flowers (https://github.com/erikflowers/weather-icons),
icons under SIL OFL 1.1 and CSS under MIT. The project stopped at this version
in 2017 and npm only has 1.3.2, so the files live here instead of in
package.json. They came from cdnjs and matched its published SRI hashes. The
stylesheet's @font-face lists only woff2 and woff, and its source map comment
is gone, since the map was never hosted anywhere.
